snippet.title: PSYCHO DEAD | Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A third-person survival horror game. The story follows a girl with psychic power who tries to escape a secret laboratory swarming with grotesque and monstrous creatures. Uncover the truth behind the incident and embark on a thrilling adventure that'll keep you on the edge. Explore a sci-fi setting filled with mystery and danger, where a terror is waiting to attack you.

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018390/PSYCHO_DEAD/

---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
